cues: Distil a fermented wash, and the alcohol concentration climbs.
But it stops dead at ninety five point six percent.
At that point ethanol and water form an azeotrope, a constant boiling mixture whose vapour has exactly the same composition as the liquid.
No amount of extra distillation gets past it.
text: Distil a fermented wash, and the alcohol concentration climbs. But it stops dead at ninety five point six percent. At that point ethanol and water form an azeotrope, a constant boiling mixture whose vapour has exactly the same composition as the liquid. No amount of extra distillation gets past it. This is rectified spirit.
